versions.changelog: M 维度突破 - 已上架 ClawHub，添加用户反馈收集机制

first-principle-analyzer v0.1.1

- Major project restructuring: added 58 new files for documentation and test coverage, including detailed evolution docs and coverage reports.
- Introduced version history and changelog files for improved tracking.
- Simplified and focused skill description and documentation for clarity.
- Removed outdated upload instruction files.
- Updated package information to reflect initial open-source structure.

first-principle-analyzer v2.4.0

- Updated version to 2.4.0 in SKILL.md and package.json.
- Added CLAWHUB-UPLOAD-v2.4.md for release/upload tracking.
- No changes to main feature set or documentation content.

- Expanded SKILL.md with detailed usage scenarios, step-by-step workflow, and example commands.
- Added comprehensive descriptions for each of the 7 analysis phases with checklists and verification standards.
- Included quick start and advanced usage instructions for installing and running the skill.
- Added frequently asked questions, success stories, and technical support contacts.
- Updated documentation to be more user-friendly, with clearer structure and practical examples.
- package.json updated to version 2.3.1.

first-principle-analyzer v2.3.0

- Major documentation and structure update: unified SKILL.md with concise description, features, pricing, and FAQ.
- Removed legacy and redundant files, including previous changelog/history and evolution docs.
- Added CLAWHUB-UPLOAD.md for distribution/compliance.
- Modernized metadata, versioning, and usage scenarios for improved clarity.
- Aligned pricing/plans and frequently asked questions with current offering.

first-principle-analyzer v0.1.0 - 初始版本上线

- 提供完整的第一性原理分析流程，包括「质疑-分解-验证-重构」
- 支持多类型场景：技术、商业、产品、人生、学术
- 结构化分阶段交互指引与实例输出
- 强调假设识别与连续「为什么」深挖至基本真理
- 自动生成结构化 MarkDown 报告，便于分享和归档
